notes.title: Patch 1.1.3
notes.content:
Balancing

The price of the saving cake has been significantly reduced (300 > 70 gold).


Bug fixes and optimisation

Occasional freezes that block images but not sound should be fixed.
The controllers should now work better, but we do not guarantee full compatibility.
Osnarl in Goldmoon is now selling the right warhammer.
Merry's in-battle sprites now display the correct weapon equipped.


News and changes

New option to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode.
The F5 Key as been disabled to avoid unintentional restart.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
Balancing

Guard Helrey joins the fight at a higher level.
Frey's stats are slightly higher to simplify the beginning of the game.
The guard's armour stats have been slightly increased.


Bug fixes and optimisation

Fixed the Guard Helrey being able to join the fight without weapons.


News and changes

Cahertis now launches in full screen.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Overhaul of durability feature

The weapons or equipment obtained are now new.
The repair price in the Armoury is reduced by 1 gold per point of durability.
The price of sharpening stones is decreasing (220 > 150 gold).
The price of repair kits decreases by 1 gold per durability point repaired. 
Repair kit: 50 > 40 gold.
Repair kit +: 135 > 105 gold.
Repair kit ++: 600 > 420 gold.
Immutability kit: 2000 > 1800 gold.
The maximum durability value of an equipment now depends on its rarity.
Common: 100 > 75 points.
Refined: 100 > 90 points.
Rare: remains at 100 points.
Very rare: 100 > 110 points.
Epic: 100 > 120 points.
Legendary: 100 > 140 points. 


Balancing

The basic inventory space increases (80 > 140 slots).
The additional inventory space per companion decreases (18 > 15 slots).


Bug fixes and optimisation

Fixed the movement of the guards in cutscene.
Fixed weapons and equipment where runes were not usable.
Fixed validation of some quests.
Fixed the Pauillac quest.
Fixed skill grimoires that do not teach skills.
Fixed the nature of solidary rage.
The pop-up at game launch now only appears once.
Lexand no longer sees Frey flying home if he is no longer there.
Fixed full repair in Armoury when the team was not full.
Fixed a memory leak when exiting multi-page books.
Fixed the animation of Gebeorht.
Fixed Hylley Sentinel's movement animation.
Various translation fixes.
Various dialogue fixes.


News and changes

Added the key assigned to pickpocketing to the mastery description.
Addition of a document presenting the hierarchy of the guard in the Headquarters.
The battle interface can now display up to 8 states.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
Balancing

Armoury repair price increases by 1 gold per durability point.
Standard inventory slot increases (80 > 110 slots).
Additional inventory slot per companion decreases (18 > 15 slots).


Bug fixes and optimisation

Fixed the nature of solidarity rage.
The pop-up at game launch now only appears once.
Lexand no longer sees Frey stealing from his house if he's not there.
Fixed the repair option from Armouries when the team was not complete.
Fixed a memory leak when exiting multi-page books.
Fixed Gebeorht's animation.
Fixed Sentinel Hylley's movement animation.
Various translation fixes.


News and changes

Added a document showing the hierarchy of the guard in Headquarters.
The combat interface can now display up to 8 states.
